title: floats inside composites compare numerically, as scalar ==
purpose: -0.0 == 0.0 at every nesting level: arrays, nested arrays, objects, a cycle through an escaped self, variant payloads, map values and keys; contains, index_of, array difference and Atomic.compare_and_replace agree with ==; the sign itself is kept.
